Specification: This specification models the Raft consensus algorithm at a high level by defining an initial state, a next-state relation over client, server, log, and message behavior, and a simple safety invariant over committed log entries. The model includes server restarts, follower and candidate timeouts, leader election steps, client session and request actions, log replication, message receipt, duplication, and dropping, so the fault model includes message loss and duplication as well as server restarts. The temporal behavior is captured by a standard initialization-and-step specification `Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars`, and the file also defines an invariant asserting agreement of committed log entries across servers.
